Solution: (3/5) ÷ (2/9) = (3/5)*(9/2) = 27/10 = 2.7. The quotient is the amount per one unit of the denominator quantity. Check: rate × the original time/input recovers the original amount. Exact calculation: (3 ÷ 5) ÷ (2 ÷ 9) = 2.7.

Question Choices: 18 is what percent of 72? (Enter only the number)
Hints: Divide part by whole, then multiply by 100.
Solution: 18 ÷ 72 = 1/4 = 25%. Percent means per hundred: part ÷ whole × 100. Calculation: 18 ÷ 72 × 100 = 25. Enter 25, the percent number.
